name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: panes, tools and hooks that live inside a session

plugins.name: breadcrumbs
plugins.description: A pane beside the session that Claude talks to you through: the task, what it is doing, the notes it files, the questions it went on without, and manual tests you run when you get to them.

plugins.name: breadcrumbs-launcher
plugins.description: Starts breadcrumbs' manual-test testers the moment you press Start, without going through the main agent.

plugins.name: secrets
plugins.description: Hand Claude an API token without it reading the value: you type it into a field above the prompt, Claude uses it in Bash as $NAME, and it is redacted from every tool result.
